en: A colorized historical postcard showing a bustling harbor scene with several docked boats and barges alongside a quay. Cranes and small warehouses line the waterfront, with workers and figures visible on the pier. Palm trees and low buildings appear in the background. The caption at the bottom, printed in red, identifies the location as the Beira Port in Portuguese East Africa and provides the name in Portuguese and English.
